info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Quant Model Submission API
info.description: The Quant Model Submission API enables financial analysts and data scientists to submit and integrate quantitative models to enhance market data analytics. This API supports the onboarding of new risk models, which can then be utilized for forecasting and decision-making in banking and investment applications. Typical consumers include fintech companies, investment banks, and quantitative research teams looking to leverage advanced algorithms in their market strategies. Through this API, users can streamline the process of model deployment and improve the efficiency of their market analysis workflows.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new quantitative model in the system. It expects model parameters in the request body and will respond with the details of the newly created model.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a quant model for processing. Ensure that the JSON structure adheres to the specified schema to avoid errors during submission.
